intent: Phase 2 cover and traversal blockout. Every placement is a route decision, sightline break, terrain grade, or future cover anchor. This file does not create AI, combat, damage, hazards, Archive interior, Archive Computer, or Data Core interaction.

route_clearance.reason: All basin pieces sit outside the 6m central spine; they make side lanes legible without sealing the direct approach to the Sentinel Archive.
The east terrace is set back from the bridge foot so the exposed high flank remains an uninterrupted connector.
Landing berm and west terrace frame the catwalk choice but leave its 1.6m connector clear.
The canyon salvage pod is offset east of the 4.5m descent and provides a low-route cover anchor without entering its capsule corridor.

placements.purpose: Landing Ridge hard cover: breaks the first open view from the primary insertion and makes the west catwalk choice read as a flank rather than loose scenery.
Scrapper Basin west-side low hard cover. Its offset keeps the central spine open and produces a left-side approach decision.
Robot salvage hard cover on the east basin lane. The visible repair arm and diagnostic strip explain why machinery is in the basin; it is a future cover anchor, not an enemy.
Tall east-side cryogenic bulkhead that interrupts a long basin-to-archive sightline while preserving the central and east-bridge lanes around it.
Archive approach terrain cover. It gives the western approach a distinct pre-Archive angle without occupying the open Sentinel door line.
West Scrapper Basin terrace: three physical ice steps turn the basin edge into readable high ground beside, not across, the preserved central route.
East basin terrace visually connects the open bridge flank to a raised ice shelf, giving a high/low read without blocking the east bridge connector.
Lower Canyon maintenance-shell cover. It makes the lower flank look serviced by robot machinery and sits east of the connector corridor for a genuine low-route sight break.
